# Draft:Nguyen Huy Hoang, agriculture's and artist

Nguyễn Huy Hoàng (born 1996) is a Vietnamese agricultural entrepreneur, singer, and content creator. He is known for founding the Hoàng Phát Green Agriculture model in Vietnam's Central Highlands, which focuses on sustainable farming practices and the integration of technology into agricultural production.
In addition to his work in agriculture, Hoàng has released music on digital platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, and Tidal.
Early life
Nguyễn Huy Hoàng was born in Đắk Nông Province, Vietnam, and has ancestral roots in Hà Tĩnh Province. Growing up in a rural environment, he developed an early interest in improving agricultural productivity and promoting sustainable farming models.
Career
Agriculture
Hoàng began his career in agriculture with the aim of building efficient and sustainable farming systems. His work includes the distribution of agricultural supplies, technical consulting, and the development of agricultural value chains.
Hoàng Phát Green Agriculture
Hoàng Phát Green Agriculture is an agricultural initiative founded by Hoàng. The model emphasizes the application of modern technology in farming to enhance productivity while ensuring environmental sustainability.
The initiative focuses on:
* Supplying agricultural inputs
* Providing technical farming guidance
* Promoting sustainable agricultural development
Music
Alongside his agricultural activities, Hoàng produces and releases music inspired by rural life, nature, and the Central Highlands region.
